goal: Find up to three Apple stories on the Hacker News front page, and judge whether the first three comments on each are optimistic, pessimistic, or neutral.

task.instruction: Select only stories specifically about Apple Inc. (the technology company, its hardware, software, services, or history, such as iPhone, Mac, iPad, iOS, macOS, Apple Card, Steve Jobs). Do not select stories about apple the fruit, agriculture, or other unrelated tech topics. Return an empty list if no stories are about Apple Inc.
Judge whether this comment expresses an optimistic, pessimistic, or neutral sentiment.

title: Hacker News Apple Stories Comment Sentiment
